answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil swarms by placing liveness behind a memory-hard velvet rope. Verifiers broadcast a challenge pulse each epoch, and agents must echo that nonce inside a memory-hard hash bound to their public key within a tight deadline. Because concurrent proofs need separate scratchpads, scaling fake keys requires linear DRAM capacity and bandwidth per identity. However, rented cloud fleets can still outscale honest nodes, and repeated proving wastes substantial energy.
